items.description: PR #412 feat/playtest-visual-harness — interactive visual hex-grid layer for PlaytestHarness. Rebased onto main 2026-05-18 after #408 merge; integrates with the reaction modal + ready-reactions panel by lifting the reaction overlay out of the dev grid so it stays reachable in 'Map only' mode. Single-commit rebase replaced the original 23258c5 + 69c6e2e. 83 vitest cases pass; CI green; awaits Kirk merge + MCP playtest verification.

PR #408 feat/wave-2.11d-reaction-ui-407 — Wave 2.11d reaction UI infrastructure (modal + ready-reactions panel + SetReactionReady hook + #409/#410/#411 follow-ups). Merged to main 2026-05-18 (commit 0cf1f61).

rpg-api-protos#158 — expose reaction_readiness in EncounterStateData snapshot. Tracks the proto extension needed so the web panel can shed the #410 tri-state affordance and read server-seeded defaults (OA default-on for melee combatants at AddPlayer) directly from the snapshot.
PR #379 docs/honest-status-snapshot — bootstrap doc tree (architecture/overview.md, data-model.md, components/*.md, how-to/*.md).

PR #377 fix/376-room-revealed-all-rooms — calls allRoomsFromEncounterState in handleRoomRevealed instead of roomFromEncounterState. Paused pending confirmation that RoomRevealed events reach browser (issue #380).

PR #378 test/room-reveal-transforms — extracts 5 transform functions from LobbyView.tsx to utils/encounterStateTransforms.ts with 25 tests. Paused alongside #377. IMPORTANT: these 25 tests are NOT on main — the status.md claim about commit 15f232e merging to main was incorrect.
PR #370 fix/hex-entity-equipment-fallback — resolves weapons/shields from itemId fallback when equipment data is missing. Independently useful, unblocked by stream issue.

Issue #380 — stream delivery investigation. RoomRevealed confirmed to fire on API side (open_door_test.go). Whether it reaches browser via gRPC-Web is unconfirmed. Use Chrome DevTools on port 9222 (scripts/rpg-chrome.sh) to check Network tab → StreamEncounterEvents → EventStream.
